INSERT INTO media_upload_parts
            (session_id, part_number, content_id, size_bytes)
        VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4)
        ON CONFLICT (session_id, part_number)
            DO UPDATE SET content_id  = EXCLUDED.content_id,
                          size_bytes  = EXCLUDED.size_bytes,
                          uploaded_at = now()
